title: Order XLI Rule 27 CPC — Additional evidence

content.overview: Additional evidence on first appeal is exceptional: refused evidence, due-diligence discovery, or the court needs it to judge.
content.study: This is not a second trial. Record why the exception applies. Section 107 is the parent power.
